turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Euphemistic labeling can be a powerful tool for manipulation, especially in politics or marketing. Think of politicians downplaying the severity of a crisis or advertisers using words like "renew" instead of "replace" to make their product seem more environmentally friendly. Linguistic grandstanding, or using words in a way that sounds impressive but lacks substance, is also related to this concept – it's all about creating a certain image or impression through language.
